still: A washed-out, grainy night-mode photograph from a fixed lens high in the sloping rafters of a cramped rented attic, looking down at Brandon lying on a bare floorboard patch between a single bed and a heap of unwashed laundry, mid-crunch, brows pulled together, eyelids half shut, mouth set in a flat grim line, eyes aimed at the ceiling. A laptop open on a cardboard box glows pale blue and is the only light besides a bare bulb that barely reaches the corners. Brandon is small in the frame, seen from above, with damp patches on the slanted plaster and a kettle on a window ledge. The frame is a locked, unattended wide shot with nobody operating it, and nothing on the picture but the room. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Brandon, small in the frame from high above, does one slow crunch up and down on the floor, his brows pinched and his jaw tight, then a second shaky one. Later, he pauses at the top, lets his shoulders sag, and glances sideways at the laptop. The bare bulb flickers faintly. The picture is shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: floorboards creaking under his back, a faint tinny voice murmuring from the laptop speaker, his breath puffing, the bulb buzzing. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

still: A flat, low-contrast frame from a fixed wide lens bolted into the corner where the attic wall meets the sloping ceiling, looking across a tiny kitchenette shelf: Brandon stands beside a dented sink with a plastic shaker bottle tipped against his mouth, head back, brows lifted, eyelids heavy, eyes aimed at the ceiling. A near-empty cupboard stands open with one sad tin visible and nothing else. The only light is a greenish fluorescent tube over the sink and a grey dawn smear through a skylight. Colours are washed out and slightly compressed, as if recorded by a lens that nobody is watching. No writing anywhere in the frame. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Brandon swings the shaker bottle in short hard shakes beside his ear, then tilts it back and drinks, throat working, brows low. Later, he lowers the bottle, looks into the empty cupboard for a beat, and closes it with his shoulder slumping. The fluorescent tube over the sink flickers. The picture is shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: the rattle of a ball inside a plastic shaker, a long gulp, a cupboard door clacking, tube buzz. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

still: A high, locked, grainy night-mode view from the rafters above a rented attic's narrow door, looking down at Brandon on the floor frozen halfway through a crunch, rigid, brows raised, eyelids wide, mouth shut tight, eyes aimed at the door. His laptop on the floor beside him throws a pale rectangle of light up his arm. A strip of landing light glows under the door and two dark shoe shapes interrupt it. The frame is washed out and hazy, the door wood is chipped and painted over several times, and a clothes rail sags beside it. Nothing is written on the picture. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Brandon holds absolutely still, hovering mid-crunch, only his chest moving as knuckles knock three times on the door. Later, the shadows under the door shift and retreat, and Brandon lets out a held breath and lowers himself slowly to the floor. The light strip under the door dims as the shadow shifts. The picture is shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: three knocks on thin wood, the laptop murmuring quietly, floorboards creaking on the landing and fading, his shaky breath. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

still: A fixed, washed-out wide view from a high corner of a different cheap bedsit above a closed kebab shop, looking down on a lad of about nineteen with a patchy moustache, a stained grey tracksuit top and one sock, mid-crunch on a thin brown carpet beside a mattress on pallets. A tall fan heater with an orange bar glows by the wall, and a wardrobe has no door. A phone propped against a mug is the only other glow. Compressed colour, grain in the shadows, a lens with no operator. No writing or numbers on the picture. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. The lad does a crunch with his hands behind his head, his face scrunched, then another, sloppier one. Later, he rolls onto an elbow and scratches his stomach, staring at the propped phone. The orange bar of the fan heater pulses. The picture is shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: heater ticking, carpet rubbing against his tracksuit, a delivery moped passing outside, a groan. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

still: A locked, desaturated view from a shelf above a door, looking down into a student-house box room where a heavyset lad in a faded football shirt and checked pyjama bottoms stands at a narrow desk, shoulders hunched, shaking a plastic bottle of powder and milk in both hands. A cheap lamp with a crooked shade lights one side of his face, and the rest is murk. Posters curl off the wall, a bin overflows with takeaway cartons, and a radiator ticks beneath a sash window with a streetlamp glow. Grain and slight blur, no operator, nothing written on the frame. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. The lad shakes the bottle hard in front of his chest, then unscrews the lid and sniffs it, his nose wrinkling. Later, he glances over his shoulder at the door, takes a swig, and gags quietly. The crooked lamp flickers once. The picture is shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: powder sloshing in a bottle, a lid squeaking, a cough, a radiator knocking. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

still: A locked, dim, grainy night frame from a lens fixed in the rafters of the attic, looking down on Brandon hunched on the edge of a bare mattress with his phone held close to his face, thumbs poised, brows drawn together, eyelids narrowed, lips slightly parted, eyes aimed at the device. The phone's glow is a pale cold wash on his chin and nose, and its face is turned away from us as a blur of light. The rest of the attic is almost black apart from the edge of a pillow and a mug on the floor. The colour is washed out and compressed. Nothing is written on the picture. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Brandon types with both thumbs in short bursts, his lips moving silently, then stops and stares at the phone. Later, he leans back a few centimetres, rubs his eye with the heel of his hand and shifts his weight on the mattress. The phone glow flickers across his chin as the screen changes. The picture is shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: soft thumb taps, a mattress spring creaking, a faint phone buzz, wind against the skylight. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

still: A webcam-quality frame, slightly too wide and sitting at chest height on a shelf, of an enormous tanned bodybuilder with a shaved head and a ginger beard standing in a garage home gym, chest forward, brows raised, eyes aimed straight at the lens, mouth open mid-sentence with total confidence. Rubber flooring, a rack of mismatched plates, a rowing machine and a mirror with a smeared handprint fill the room. A harsh white garage strip light overhead blows out the pale roller door behind him, colours bleached and compressed. No writing or numbers appear on the picture. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. The bodybuilder talks at the lens, jabbing a thick finger downward, rolling his shoulders and pointing to the rack beside him. Later, he nods slowly at his own point and flexes one arm, then grins. The garage strip light flickers faintly. The picture is shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: a loud echoing garage hum, plates clinking on a rack, his shoes squeaking on rubber, a muffled indistinct boom of voice. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

still: A high locked wide view from a ceiling corner of a cheap council-run gym, looking down at Brandon lying on a padded bench under a loaded bar on a rack, small and seen from above, brows crushed together, eyelids squeezed, mouth stretched in a grimace, one arm visibly trembling. A cracked mirror wall, a rubber floor with peeling tape, and two empty treadmills sit behind him. Flat fluorescent tubes give a washed-out green-white light, one tube dimmer than the rest. The frame is grainy, compressed, with nobody behind the lens. No writing on the picture. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Brandon strains under the bar with his trembling arm, his face reddening, his legs scrabbling on the bench. Later, he holds the bar at the top for a second with his arm wobbling, and a gym-goer in the distance glances over. The dim tube above flickers. The picture is shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: straining breath, the bench creaking, a treadmill belt whirring in the distance, the tube buzzing. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

still: A locked, washed-out wide view from a high corner of the cheap gym, looking down at Brandon sitting on the rubber floor beside a bench, clutching one arm against his chest, brows raised and bunched, eyelids pinched, mouth open, eyes aimed at the floor. Three gym-goers stand around the edges of the frame, turning their heads towards him: a man in a vest with a towel, a woman on a rowing machine, a teenager in a hoodie. The bar rests on its rack above the bench, level and still. The fluorescent tubes are flat and greenish, the mirror is cracked, and nothing is written on the picture. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Brandon rocks gently forward on the floor, holding his arm to his chest while the three gym-goers turn their heads and step slowly towards him. Later, the man in the vest lowers his towel from his shoulder and stands still, staring, while the woman stops rowing. A fluorescent tube flickers overhead. The picture is shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: a low moan, a rowing machine chain winding down, trainers squeaking, tube hum. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

still: A flat, bleached, slightly wide frame from a small lens mounted in the top corner of an ambulance's rear compartment, looking down along the length of the stretcher. Brandon lies on it with his arm wrapped in thick white bandage and strapped across his chest, his other hand clutching a plastic protein shake bottle, brows raised, eyelids heavy, mouth pressed shut, eyes aimed at Sophie. Sophie sits on the jump seat to his left in her green paramedic uniform, leaning in with one hand reaching for the bottle, her brows slightly lowered, eyelids tired, mouth soft. A cold white strip light above them washes out colour, and cabinets with latches and folded blankets line the walls. Nothing is written on the picture. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Sophie's hand slides gently around the shake bottle while Brandon tightens his grip for a moment, then loosens it and lets her take it. Later, Brandon's head lolls back on the pillow, and Sophie sets the bottle on a shelf and tucks a blanket higher on his chest. The strip light vibrates faintly with the engine. The picture is shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: engine drone, tyres on tarmac, plastic creaking as the bottle is eased free, a stretcher strap clicking. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

still: A grainy, bleached frame from a lens fixed above the stretcher inside the ambulance, closer, looking down at Brandon's head and shoulders on a thin pillow, his bandaged arm strapped across his chest, brows pulled up in the middle, eyelids fluttering half shut, mouth open as if starting a sentence and failing, eyes aimed at the ceiling light. A cold white strip light fills the frame, with red blanket edges and a corner of a cabinet visible at the edges. The colours are drained and compressed, nobody operates the lens, and nothing is written on the picture. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Brandon's lips part and close several times as he tries to form a sentence, his brows working and his chin trembling. Later, he gives up, closes his eyes and lets his head sink deeper into the pillow. The white strip light shudders slightly with the road. The picture is shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: engine drone, a monitor beeping slowly, a stretcher rattle, a ragged breath. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

still: A locked, murky, grainy night view from a lens high in the attic rafters, looking down at Brandon on his narrow bed, turned away from us on his side with the duvet pulled up to his ears and one arm in a white cast resting on top of the cover, the whole shape small and still. A thin line of orange from a streetlamp enters through the skylight and lies across the floorboards, and a laptop lid on the floor is closed. A mug and a pill packet sit on a crate beside the bed. The colours are washed out, there is no writing on the picture, and nothing explicit is shown. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Brandon's shoulders rise and fall slowly beneath the duvet, then give two small shudders. Later, he pulls the cast arm closer to his chest and goes still. The streetlamp light on the floorboards flickers as a car passes. The picture is shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: rain on the skylight, a sniff, the bed frame creaking, a car passing outside. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

still: A locked, washed-out view from a lens high in the corner of a shared bathroom, looking down at Brandon standing at a chipped basin with one arm in a cast, brows pulled together, eyelids heavy, mouth slack, eyes aimed at a dripping tap. His phone is propped against the mirror on the sink's edge, its face turned away as a blur of light. The room has yellowed tiles, a mouldy shower curtain, a bare bulb in a cage, and a pile of towels on a radiator. Colours are bleached and compressed, with grain in the shadows, and nothing is written anywhere on the picture. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Brandon stares at the tap while a drop forms and falls into the basin, and he lifts his good hand and rubs the back of his neck. Later, he leans in toward the phone, squints at it, and then straightens with his brows lifting slowly. The caged bulb hums and flickers. The picture is shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: slow drips echoing on enamel, a pipe ticking in the wall, the bulb buzzing, a distant toilet flush. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

still: A steady, slightly soft frame from a phone leaned on the lip of a bathtub, looking at a calm, kind man in his fifties with a weathered face and a grey stubble jaw, wearing faded blue overalls, kneeling on a tiled floor beside a basin, one hand resting on a copper pipe under it, eyes aimed warmly at the lens, mouth mid-sentence. A window with frosted glass pours flat daylight across the room and bleaches the tiles behind him. A toolbag sits open at his knee, and nothing is written on the picture. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. The plumber talks to the lens with an easy nod, then taps the pipe under the basin twice with a knuckle. Later, he gestures to a valve with an open palm and gives a small reassuring smile. A soft breath of wind moves the net curtain in the frosted window. The picture is shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: a knuckle knocking on copper, the metallic clink of a spanner in the toolbag, a gentle drip, a muffled murmur of voice. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

still: A locked, grainy, desaturated wide view from a lens in the top corner of the shared bathroom, looking down at Brandon crouched awkwardly under the basin with one arm in a cast, his good hand on a pipe valve, brows raised, eyelids wide, mouth open, eyes aimed at the water. A fan of water bursts outward from the pipes, spreading in a bright sheet across the floor tiles and over his hoodie. A caged bulb overhead blows out the wet highlights, towels slump on the radiator, and his phone sits on the sink's edge with its face turned away. Colour is bleached, and nothing is written on the picture. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Water streams outward from under the basin and spreads across the tiles while Brandon flinches back, arm raised across his face, and scrambles on his heels. Later, he slumps, kneeling in the spreading puddle, and looks up at the ceiling with his shoulders dropping. The caged bulb flickers. The picture is shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: a loud hiss of pressurised water, splashing across tiles, a yelp, a pipe thudding in the wall. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

still: A fixed, slightly fisheyed, washed-out view from a lens on a kitchen shelf, looking across a small downstairs flat kitchen at Jenny standing at a counter with a mug in one hand, head tipped back, brows raised high, eyelids wide, mouth open, eyes aimed at the ceiling. The plaster above her sags in a heavy brown bulge, with water streaming from a crack and splashing on the lino beside her. A pendant light swings slightly, a calendar hangs on the fridge door, and the colours are bleached with grain. Nothing is written on the picture. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Jenny stares upward as the bulge in the ceiling swells and water pours from the crack into a widening puddle, and she steps back a pace with her mug lowered. Later, she turns her head toward the door and puts a hand to her mouth. The pendant light sways gently. The picture is shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: heavy water pattering on lino, a plaster creak, the mug ringing against the counter, a sharp intake of breath. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

still: A bright, blown-out laptop-webcam frame of a shiny young man with too many teeth, glossy hair and a tight shirt, sitting in a white-walled room with a ring light glowing a pale halo in his eyes, one hand raised with fingers spread, counting things off, brows lifted, eyes aimed straight at the lens, a huge grin showing a row of teeth. A window behind him burns out to white, a fake plant sits on a shelf, and the colours are washed and slightly compressed. Nothing is written on the picture. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. The young man ticks off three fingers one by one, nodding at each, then flashes both palms toward the lens. Later, he leans in a few centimetres, widening his grin, and raises his brows. The ring light shimmers faintly in his eyes. The picture is shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: a hollow, echoing small-room hum, a chair creaking, a finger tapping a desk, a bright indistinct burble of voice. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

still: A distorted, wide, bleached fisheye view from a small lens mounted at the side of a front door, looking out at Brandon on the step of a terraced house, standing stiffly upright with his shoulders thrown back, one hand raised in a rehearsed wave, brows lifted, eyelids wide, mouth stretched in a fixed smile, eyes aimed straight at the lens. His cast arm hangs by his side. A hanging basket, a wheelie bin and a wet pavement sit behind him in flat grey afternoon light, with colours washed out and grain in the shadows. Nothing is written on the picture. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Brandon waves once and raises his chin, holding the stiff smile while rocking onto his toes. Later, his smile twitches, his eyes dart sideways, and his raised hand lowers a few centimetres. The hanging basket sways in a light breeze. The picture is shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: a chime ringing once, wind hissing across the lens, a car engine passing, trainers shuffling on a stone step. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

still: A distorted, wide, washed-out fisheye view from a small lens at the side of a front door, looking out at Brandon on the step of a terraced house, shoulders collapsing forward, his raised hand dropping to his side, brows tilted up in the middle, eyelids low, mouth pulled flat, eyes aimed at the door. The front door's inside edge is just shut in the foreground, a hanging basket and a wheelie bin sit behind him, and flat grey light bleaches the pavement. Grain in the shadows, nothing written on the picture. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Brandon stands frozen for a second, then his shoulders slump and his head sags forward. Later, he turns slowly on the step, looks over his shoulder at the door, and walks out of frame to the left. The hanging basket sways in the breeze. The picture is shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: a latch clicking, wind across the lens, trainers scuffing a stone step and fading, a distant dog barking. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

still: A high, locked, washed-out wide view from a lens above the till of a cheap cafe-restaurant, looking down on Brandon sitting alone at a table for two with a sauce bottle and a paper napkin in front of him, shoulders hunched, brows pinched, eyelids low, mouth tight, eyes aimed at the empty chair. Behind him, a woman in a long coat walks away through the glass door with her back to us, a bell above it swinging. Orange pendant lamps give a yellowish light, a laminated menu leans on the table, a fridge hums in the corner, and the colours are bleached with grain. Nothing is written on the picture. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. The woman pushes the door open and walks out without looking back while Brandon sits unmoving, then slowly lowers his gaze to the table. Later, he picks up the paper napkin, turns it over in his hand and sets it down again. The pendant lamp above him sways slightly after the door swings. The picture is shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: a door bell jingling, the door thudding shut, a fridge humming, cutlery clinking from the kitchen. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.
